Length frequency of the catch with the DSL reference points

Source: R/hr_techreport_plot_rfb.R
hr_techreport_plot_dsl_lc.Rd

The length distribution of the catch with L_c (red bar), 50\ modal abundance, L_inf, the largest length, the 99th percentile of the survey lengths and L_F=M (coloured lines), as the old R/04-DSL.R of Norway redfish. Labels follow getOption("hr.lang").

Usage

hr_techreport_plot_dsl_lc(basis, x_limits = c(0, 45))

Arguments

basis

As hr_techreport_dsl_basis.

x_limits

Lengths (cm) shown. Default c(0, 45).

Value

A ggplot2 plot object.
